source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 玉屏山 / 天湖开场
purpose: Fresh next-segment seed after EP01 SC04. Supersedes the older SC01-only next-segment seed for forward production planning.

continuity_from.caveat: SC04 is still pending real human review. Use this seed to prepare next-stage storyboards and workflows, not to bypass formal approval.

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, relic bundle.
White dragon-deer must remain a friendly mythic mount: white deer body, pearl neck and shoulder scales, pale jade antlers, long white mane, calm intelligent eyes.
Wufeng must remain a plain dark blunt rectangular edgeless black iron object, not a sharp sword.
Yuping Mountain / Tianhu must read as moonlit pine and bamboo sanctuary, clear heavenly lake, austere wooden and bamboo pavilions, jade-green mist, forbidden quiet.
Do not show Qingdi directly in this segment. Let the empty courtyard and unseen authority create the hook.
Do not generate formal episode video from this seed until storyboard review passes and EP01 human review remains respected.

generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: experimental_file_ids only while current local backend supports it; otherwise use official T2V smoke tests or switch provider for formal I2V
generation_policy.review_gate: storyboards must pass human or explicit operator review before I2V; I2V candidates must pass human review before formal cut
